lines.t: Good morning, and here is the weather for the week. Today will be cloudy in the north, with some rain in the afternoon. The temperature will be around twelve degrees.
In the south, it will be warm and sunny. It will reach twenty-two degrees, so it is a good day for the beach.
Tomorrow, strong winds will come from the west. Please be careful if you are driving near the coast.
On Wednesday, it will be very cold at night, and there may be fog on the roads early in the morning.
From Thursday, the weather will get better. We will see more sun, and the rain will stop.
By the weekend, it will be warm and dry everywhere, with a high of twenty degrees. Enjoy your week!

qs.q: What is the weather in the north today?
qs.why: قال: cloudy in the north with some rain.

qs.q: The temperature in the south will reach ___ degrees.
Tomorrow, the wind will come from the east.
What may happen early on Wednesday morning?
qs.why: قال: there may be fog on the roads.

qs.q: The weather will get better from ___.
What will the weekend be like?

lines.t: Hello, Sunrise Homes. Can I help you?
Yes. I saw your advert for a flat in Green Street. Is it still free?
Yes, it is. It has two bedrooms, a small kitchen and a balcony.
How much is the rent?
It is four hundred and fifty dollars a month, and the water is included.
What about the internet?
You pay for that yourself. It is about twenty dollars a month.
Is the flat near a bus stop?
Yes, the bus stop is two minutes from the door. The supermarket is also very close.
Good. Can I see the flat tomorrow?
Of course. Come at four o'clock. You must bring your passport or identity card.
Okay. My name is Yusuf. Thank you for your help.

qs.q: Where is the flat?
qs.why: قال: a flat in Green Street.

qs.q: The flat has ___ bedrooms.
The monthly rent is ___ dollars.
qs.why: قالت: four hundred and fifty dollars.

qs.q: What is included in the rent?
The bus stop is far from the flat.
qs.why: محطة الحافلة على بعد دقيقتين من الباب.

qs.q: What time is the visit?

title: A teacher explains the week's timetable

lines.t: Good morning, class. Before we start, here is our timetable for this week.
On Monday, we have grammar at nine o'clock and reading at eleven.
On Tuesday, there is no class in the morning because I have a meeting. We will meet at two in the afternoon for speaking practice.
On Wednesday, we have a computer lesson in room twelve, not in our usual room. Please remember to bring headphones.
On Thursday, there is a short test. It is about the words from units five and six, so please study them at home.
On Friday, we will go to the library for an hour. We finish early, at twelve, so you can go home for lunch.
Please write this in your notebooks. Are there any questions?

qs.q: What is at nine o'clock on Monday?
There is a morning class on Tuesday.
qs.why: لا يوجد درس صباحاً لأن المعلمة لديها اجتماع.

qs.q: The computer lesson is in room ___.
What must students bring on Wednesday?
What is the test about?
On Friday, the class finishes at ___.
qs.why: قالت: We finish early, at twelve.

lines.t: Next, please. How can I help you?
Hello. I want to send this parcel to Canada.
Let me see. Please put it on the scale. It is two kilos.
How long will it take?
By air, it takes about five days. By sea, it takes a month.
By air, please. How much is it?
Eighteen dollars. Do you want to add insurance? It is only three dollars more.
No, thank you. It is just some books for my sister.
Okay. Please fill in this form with her address and your phone number.
Can I also buy two stamps for letters?
Yes. Stamps are one dollar each.
Here is a twenty-dollar bill. Thank you.
Your change is two dollars after the parcel. Have a good day.

qs.q: Where does the man want to send the parcel?
The parcel weighs ___ kilos.
qs.why: قال الموظف: It is two kilos.

qs.q: How long does air mail take?
The man buys insurance.
What is inside the parcel? ___
qs.why: قال: just some books for my sister.

qs.q: How much is one stamp?

lines.t: Attention, please. Good afternoon, shoppers, and welcome to Fresh Mart.
This week, we have some special offers. Apples are only two dollars a kilo, and a loaf of brown bread costs one dollar fifty.
On the first floor, all winter coats are half price. Please visit the clothes department near the escalator.
Today only, children can enjoy a free ice cream from the cafe on the ground floor. Please ask the staff at the desk.
We also have a message for the owner of a blue car, number plate four four seven. Your lights are on. Please come back to your car.
Fresh Mart closes at nine o'clock tonight. Thank you for shopping with us.

qs.q: How much are apples this week?
A loaf of brown bread costs one dollar ___.
What is half price?
The free ice cream is for adults.
The blue car's number plate is ___.
What time does the shop close?

title: A phone call to a hotel

lines.t: Good evening, Lake View Hotel. Anna speaking.
Hello. I have a reservation for tomorrow, but I need to change it.
Certainly. What is your name, please?
It is Hassan Omar.
Thank you, Mr Omar. You have a single room for two nights, from the fifth of May.
Yes. Can I arrive one day later, on the sixth, and stay for three nights?
Let me check. Yes, that is possible. The price is the same, ninety pounds a night.
Is breakfast included?
Yes, breakfast is from seven to ten in the dining room.
Perfect. Also, I will arrive late, at about eleven at night. Is that a problem?
No, the reception is open all night.
Thank you very much for your help.

qs.q: The guest's family name is ___.
What was the first booking?
What new date will he arrive?
The room costs ___ pounds a night.
Breakfast is included in the price.
qs.why: قالت: Yes, breakfast is from seven to ten.

qs.q: What time will he arrive?

lines.t: Last summer, my family and I went to Turkey for two weeks. We flew from Algiers to Istanbul, and the flight took about four hours.
We stayed in a small hotel near the sea. The rooms were clean, and the people there were very kind. Every morning, we ate breakfast on the roof and watched the boats.
In the first week, we visited the old market and a famous museum. My brother bought a leather jacket, and I bought some sweets for my friends.
In the second week, we took a boat trip to an island. The water was warm, and we swam every day.
The only bad thing was the weather on the last day. It rained all morning, so we stayed in the hotel and played cards.
It was a great holiday, and I want to go again next year.

qs.q: How long was the holiday?
The flight took about ___ hours.
Where did they eat breakfast?
What did the brother buy?
They took a boat trip in the first week.
qs.why: الرحلة بالقارب كانت في الأسبوع الثاني.

qs.q: On the last day, they played ___.
